program_name: Marine Biology and Blue Biotechnologies [uncertain] (the programme's own /en site header instead reads 'Corso di laurea in Marine Sciences and Blue Biotechnologies'; the profile block and page title use 'Marine Biology and Blue Biotechnologies' — the official site is internally inconsistent about the English name).
teaching_language: English — confirmed both in the programme profile ('Language: English') and on the admission-requirements page ('Language(s) of instruction/examination: ENGLISH'). The programme is genuinely fully English-taught (an /en site exists and is functionally equivalent to the /it site's admission-page content, which is itself in Italian on both language versions of the site).
academic_requirements: Possession of a secondary-school diploma (or a foreign qualification deemed equivalent by competent university bodies) is required. Foreign-qualification pre-evaluation follows the guidelines of Rectoral Decree Prot. n. 25758 of 28 February 2024. General UNIME bachelor's rules also require: an official provisional Course Completion Certificate if the diploma is not yet issued; if the diploma reflects less than 12 years of schooling, either a certificate of passed first-year university exams or a Foundation Programme certificate; a University Entrance Exam Certificate if required by the candidate's home country; and a transcript of records.
language_requirements: English is required either as a native language or via adequate certification/attestation at CEFR B2 level, issued by public bodies/private structures accredited per MUR guidelines. No separate Italian-language requirement is stated for enrolment (the course is delivered in English), though UNIME offers optional Italian courses for international students more broadly.
entry_exam_or_test: A mandatory national CISIA TOLC-F test (Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Physics, Logic sections: F-1 through F-5) is administered to verify basic knowledge expected at the end of secondary school. The test is diagnostic, not exclusionary: enrolment is not conditional on passing it. Students must answer at least 15 of 50 questions correctly overall, with per-section minimums (3 Biology, 3 Chemistry, 4 Mathematics, 3 Physics, 2 Logic). Failing the threshold results in Obblighi Formativi Aggiuntivi (additional learning obligations, OFA) to be cleared during year 1 via CISIA recovery tests or by passing the corresponding first-year exam; unresolved OFA by year-end means repeating the first year.
required_documents: High school diploma (12 years of education) or official provisional Course Completion Certificate
Academic certificate of passed first-year university exams OR Foundation Programme completion certificate (if diploma reflects less than 12 years of schooling)
University Entrance Exam Certificate, if required by the candidate's home country (per UniME Entry Criteria by Country)
International English language certificate (CEFR B2) or proof of English as a native language, unless exempt
application_deadline_eu: 6th Call – No-Visa Applicants (Italians with foreign qualification, EU and EU-equivalent candidates; non-EU candidates in the EU-equivalent group must hold an Italian residence permit): July 1, 2026 (00:01 CEST) to November 20, 2026 (23:59 CET), for English-taught and Italian-taught Bachelor's Degrees. A non-refundable EUR 30.00 application fee applies (covers up to two applications). Two-portal flow: pre-evaluation application on the UniME Application Portal; if admitted, confirmation on the Universitaly portal follows (Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline for A.Y. 2026/2027 is September 1, 2026).
application_deadline_non_eu: 1st Call – Early Bird (Non-EU Study-VISA applicants): November 24, 2025 (00:01 CET) to December 22, 2025 (23:59 CET). 2nd Call – Visa Applicants: February 1, 2026 (00:01 CET) to March 31, 2026 (23:59 CEST). 3rd Call – Visa Applicants: April 13, 2026 (00:01 CEST) to May 10, 2026 (23:59 CEST). All three calls cover English-taught and Italian-taught Bachelor's Degrees. A non-refundable EUR 30.00 application fee applies (covers up to two applications). Two-portal flow: pre-evaluation application on the UniME Application Portal; upon a positive evaluation, an admission letter enables registration/confirmation on the Universitaly portal to begin the visa process (Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline for A.Y. 2026/2027 is September 1, 2026).
